name: Tracker Cleaner (local)
description: Blocks trackers and ads (incl. YouTube ads), deletes tracking cookies (instantly and every 15 min), keeps logins (Spotify, Google/YouTube). Empties the list of servers Chrome remembers. Its popup shows everything chrome-baddies finds (cookies, site storage, permissions, remembered servers, extensions, policies).; drop anything now from the popup, make drops permanent. Reports to 127.0.0.1:8088/audit.
